No(s).

Leave granted.
Aggrieved by an order dated 28.07.2014 passed by the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad in Criminal Revision No. 497 of 1988, the unsuccessful appellant therein is before us.

entities.text: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The appellant is convicted for an offence under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of six months and also pay a fine of Rs. 1,000/-.
The appellant unsuccessfully carried the matter in appeal before the learned Sessions Judge and Revision before the High Court of Allahabad.
We do not deem it necessary to give the further details in the matter.
The respondent is served but there is no appearance on behalf of the respondent State.
The offence pertains to the year 1983.
We are informed that the appellant has already undergone imprisonment for a period of 47 days.
In the circumstances, we deem it appropriate to modify the order of imprisonment by enhancing the fine to Rs. 2,000/- and reducing the sentence to a period already undergone.

The appeal is disposed of accordingly.
..........................J. (J. CHELAMESWAR) .........................J. (ABHAY MAOHAR SAPRE)
NEW DELHI JULY 27, 2015.
